definitions.explanation: The state of the tide when the water reaches its highest level. Occurs approximately twice daily due to the gravitational pull of the moon and sun.

examples.japanese: {満潮|まんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦おいた→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should check the time of high tide in advance.

examples.english: The rocky area becomes submerged at high tide.
Today's high tide is at 3 PM.

examples.english: Waves get higher at high tide, so please stay away from the shore.

examples.english: On spring tide days, the water level at high tide is higher than usual, so coastal roads can become flooded.

notes:
FORMS:
- {満|まん} (full) + {潮|ちょう} (tide)

RELATED WORDS:
- {干潮|かんちょう} (low tide) - antonym
- {潮|しお}の{満|み}ち{引|ひ}き (ebb and flow of tides)
- {引|ひ}き{潮|しお} (ebb tide)
- {上|あ}げ{潮|しお} (rising tide/flood tide)
- {大潮|おおしお} (spring tide - extreme high/low tides)
- {小潮|こしお} (neap tide - moderate tides)

SCIENCE:
- Caused by gravitational pull of {月|つき} (moon) and {太陽|たいよう} (sun)
- Occurs approximately twice daily
- Heights vary with lunar cycle

PRACTICAL USES:
- Fishing ({釣|つ}り) - fish behavior changes with tides
- {潮干狩|しおひが}り (clam digging) - done at low tide
- Surfing - wave conditions affected by tides
- Maritime navigation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満潮|まんちょう}になる (to become high tide)
- {満潮|まんちょう}の{時刻|じこく} (time of high tide)
- {満潮|まんちょう}{時|じ} (at high tide)
